method: Four sequential dedicated-VM Release SerialShort jobs: two baseline and two current runs; one launch, three warmups, three measured iterations per case per run. Values are full single-image process/file invocations, not isolated library throughput. Kernel child peak RSS is a separate untimed execution, not BenchmarkDotNet allocation. Native FFmpeg controls retain normal CPU dispatch and one codec/filter thread. No quality selection or fixture generation is timed.

regressionPolicy: Provisional guard: each current mean must be at most 20% above the slower repeated baseline mean. Flag repeats and paired native control drift of 10% or more; investigate the same input and retain flagged results without comparative claims. All 32 regression guards pass, 31 routine repeat checks pass, and the one flagged native row has a completed targeted control. Preserve identical inputs/settings/quality/bitstreams. This is an initial invocation guard, not a general throughput, memory or perceptual-quality guarantee.
